name: Loan Application-loan_lead
label: Loan Lead
description: The Loan Lead this application was converted from, if any.

name: Loan Application-tenant_id
label: Tenant
description: Row-level isolation key (spec §3.2B). Set automatically from the linked Loan Lead on creation — see los_engine.los_engine.doc_events.loan_application.

name: Loan Application-performed_by_agent
label: Performed By Agent
description: Set automatically when a Field Agent creates/edits this record on the borrower's behalf (spec §4.3 proxy-action pattern). Never set this from client-supplied data.

name: Loan Application-fldg_flag
label: FLDG Cover
description: CGTMSE and FLDG are mutually exclusive (spec §1.4) — checked against OCEN Offer.cgtmse_flag in ocen_connector.

name: Loan Application-ocen_request_id
label: OCEN Request ID
description: Set by los_engine.api.ocen_integration.submit_to_ocen() (ADR 0005) — the OCEN site's own record is the source of truth; this is a local mirror for LOS's own UI, not a Link across the site boundary.

name: Loan Application-ocen_stage
label: OCEN Stage
description: Mirrors OCEN Loan Application.ocen_stage on the OCEN site. Updated by los_engine.api.ocen_integration.receive_ocen_stage_update() when the OCEN site pushes a change — this field is never the source of truth, just a cache for LOS's own UI.
